name: Command Center
description: An agentic coding environment focused on code quality rather than just generation. Enables building multiple features simultaneously with automated refactoring, code walkthroughs for reviewing large diffs, and tools to transform AI-generated 'slop' into production-ready code. Supports local execution and custom/local models.
community_quotes: The refactorings give your LLM taste. I've never seen an LLM write code this good before.
With Command Center walkthroughs, I can get through a 400-line diff in less than half the time.
This style of working is where software engineering work is heading.
Interesting how AI is making software development dramatically faster, but quality is becoming an even bigger differentiator.
